title: 第16章 古板的副队长怎么就变成弟弟了-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    原来如此。

    秦夙听的很认真，她虽然很信任谢尘无的教学，但敏感的事还是得再多确认一次。

    “在我还没熟练掌握精神治愈的疏导方式之前，是否一定要用肢体接触的方式？”

    “是。”魏知弦答的非常笃定，“严格来说，即便熟练掌握精神治愈的疏导方式，也总是无可避免的可能需要发生肢体接触，一切都要根据疏导过程而定，视具体情况，灵活调整疏导方式。”

    秦夙最不理解的就是这一点了，“可跟别人肢体接触，按画册里写的，如果我有伴侣了呢？不影响感情吗？”

    “一名哨兵伴侣势必无法满足你对疏导频率的要求，根据经验，你至少需要五到七名有能力频繁进污染区执行任务的哨兵伴侣，才有可能不去接疏导中心的预约单，自然也就无需再跟伴侣之外的哨兵肢体接触。”

    魏知弦先耐心的回答完，才稍作停顿，“我了解过地球上的婚恋文化，对你来说，要接受1VN的关系会有点困难。”

    “何止困难。”秦夙捏捏眉心，“这可是对我固有的伦理道德认知的颠覆性挑战。”

    “不用考虑哨兵伴侣的想法，他们……包括我在内，早已适应并习惯。”

    “哈……”秦夙笑了笑，低声嘀咕，“什么习惯，还不是不够爱。”

    ？

    魏知弦快速眨动几下眼睛，“爱？”

    秦夙摆摆手，“别理我，我胡说八道的。”

    “你等等。”男人却在这个问题上十分较真，不让秦夙轻易跳过，“秦夙向导，对你来说，结为伴侣的前提是？”

    干嘛非要追问啊？

    秦夙好无奈的对上魏知弦的目光。

    也不知道是不是观察和判断失误，她怎么觉得魏知弦总是古水无波，蓝黑渐变的眸底，竟然暗藏着一份莫名的热切呢？

    “是。”她叹口气，摇摇头，“我认为，结为伴侣的前提是要有爱。”

    见魏知弦狭长的眼型都睁大变圆了。

    秦夙战术后仰几分，“这些话，在你们这个星球的人看来，很离经叛道，不可理喻吗？”

    魏知弦迅速摇头，“不，不是。”

    不是，然后呢？

    秦夙等魏知弦解释。

    他却抿起了嘴唇，低眸看着桌上的奶茶，许久都没再吭声。

​That’s it.

Qin Su listened very carefully. Although she trusted Xie Chenwu's teaching, sensitive matters still had to be confirmed one more time.

“Before I master the spiritual healing method, do I have to use physical contact?”

"Yes." Wei Zhixian answered very firmly, "Strictly speaking, even if you are proficient in spiritual healing counseling methods, it is inevitable that physical contact may be required. Everything must be based on the counseling process, and the counseling methods can be adjusted flexibly depending on the specific situation."

This is what Qin Su doesn't understand the most, "But physical contact with others, according to what is written in the album, what if I have a partner? Doesn't it affect my relationship?"

"One sentry partner will definitely not be able to meet your requirements for the frequency of grooming. According to experience, you need at least five to seven sentry partners who are capable of frequently entering the contaminated area to perform tasks. Only then will it be possible not to take the appointment form of the grooming center. Naturally, there will be no need to have physical contact with sentinels other than your partner."

Wei Zhixian answered patiently before pausing for a moment, "I have learned about the marriage and love culture on Earth. It will be a bit difficult for you to accept a 1VN relationship."

"It's more than difficult." Qin Su frowned, "This is a subversive challenge to my inherent ethical and moral cognition."

"There is no need to think about what the sentry companions think. They... including me, have already adapted and got used to it."

"Ha..." Qin Su smiled and murmured in a low voice, "What habit? It's not love enough."

?

Wei Zhixian blinked his eyes quickly several times, "Love?"

Qin Su waved his hand, "Ignore me, I'm talking nonsense."

"Wait a minute." The man was very serious about this issue and would not let Qin Su skip it easily. "Guide Qin Su, for you, what are the prerequisites for becoming a partner?"

Why do you have to ask?

Qin Suhao looked at Wei Zhixian helplessly.

She didn’t know if it was a mistake in observation or judgment, but why did she feel that Wei Zhixian was always so calm, and there was an inexplicable enthusiasm hidden in his blue-black eyes?

"Yes." She sighed and shook her head, "I think the prerequisite for becoming a partner is love."

Seeing Wei Zhixian’s narrow eyes widened and became round.

Qin Su backed down a bit, "Aren't these words very deviant and unreasonable to people on your planet?"

Wei Zhixian shook his head quickly, "No, it's not."

No, what next?

Qin Su and others asked Wei Zhixian to explain.

But he pursed his lips, looked down at the milk tea on the table, and said nothing for a long time.
